feedback: Judged before racing; nothing here states how this candidate will perform. The candidate matches the iteration 10 design, which is the best raced design so far (score 148.11, up from 132.80 at kp 3.7 and 116.27 at kp 4.0). Its controller is kp 3.4, kd 0.30, ki 0.3, base_speed 1.3, last_direction, with sensors at y 0.06, x -0.03..0.03, sensor_size 0.012 and weights [-2,-1,0,1,2]. All values are inside their contract limits. Across iterations 8 to 10 the score rose each time kp fell, and progress rose on every track (oval 0.46 to 0.64, s-bend 0.26 to 0.33). The known weaknesses are the oval steering_oscillation of 0.307 (iteration 10), which is above the 0.25 concern level, and max_error of 0.063 to 0.065 m, which has not moved with any gain, sensor y, footprint or x-spread change in iterations 0 to 10. A further kp step (for example to 3.1) or a kd step (for example to 0.35) would be untested, and no iteration remains after this one to check a regression. This is the final iteration, so a revision would not be raced in time to be measured. Approve the measured best build so that the unseen-track race runs on a known design.
requested_changes: For the record only, if a later iteration were available: test controller.kd 0.35 with kp 3.4 unchanged, because iteration 7 (kd 0.25 to 0.30) raised score from 84.33 to 93.70 while holding oval oscillation near 0.246, and oscillation is now the constraint at 0.307.
For the record only: if oval steering_oscillation stays above 0.3 after a further kp step, restore kp 3.4, since the iteration 8 to 10 trend shows lower kp raising progress.
